messages:
aria: quick check — I have PR ready to go but it's gated on an architecture/governance stamp. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9231
aria: needs RFC anchor + a short canary plan before we merge to main. RFC link: https://redwood.com/rfcs/2024/quant-cache-tiling
aria: the change is the slimline tiling for KV cache; no infra churn expected. canary plan I was thinking: 1% traffic EU, 30m monitor, rollback on token-latency > 20% or error-rate > 0.5%
jess: thanks — posting here so arch folks see it. @mike @oliver can one of you take a quick look at the RFC+SLO delta?
mike: I'll look. do you have perf numbers for the 1% traffic? rough tail lat numbers help.
aria: pasted a small run from local perf test: 
```
model: redwood-open-3b
sequence: 512
baseline p95: 220ms
post-change p95: 235ms (+6.8%)
throughput: baseline 600 toks/s, post-change 590 toks/s
memory delta: -2.1% (kv compaction)
```
aria: I also ran a short soak with 0.5% traffic in staging for 2h, no increased errors. attaching logs to PR.
jess: ok that p95 increase is small. need to call out the SLO impact in the PR description (p95 delta, canary windows, rollback criteria). can you add that? also include a short paragraph linking to the RFC section that explains safety fallback (section 3.2).
aria: will add now. also adding the RFC anchor to the PR description per policy.
oliver: quick note — does this touch any cross-tenant cache code? if so we need a security sign-off.
aria: no cross-tenant changes; only local shard tiling. verifying config flag is tenant-isolated.
mike: i'll give architecture stamp once PR description includes SLO delta + the canary yaml in the PR body. if jess is fine with the numbers i'll +1 before EOD.
jess: sounds good. also schedule merge for the Wednesday maintenance window (2024-03-27 02:00 UTC) — we prefer merges outside peak traffic.
aria: updated PR description with RFC anchor, canary yaml, and SLO delta. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9231
aria: thanks — pinging again when it's green.
deploy-bot: PR #9231: CI passed — all checks green :white_check_mark:
mike: +1 from me pending a quick read of logs. will post final LGTM in the PR thread.
jess: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
